_usage: node video/render.mjs [--config video/shots.json] [--work DIR] [--audio DIR] [--out FILE] [--crf 16] [--preset slow]. Every key below is optional; values shown are the defaults.

_markerSchema.file: work/markers.json: array of {type, t, ...}; t = seconds from the start of work/raw.webm. Order does not matter.
_markerSchema.end: {type:'end', t} last source second used (default: raw duration)
_markerSchema.scene: {type:'scene:S1', t} ... scene:S7: scene starts; voice/S1.wav is placed at the scene's output time + voiceOffset
_markerSchema.wait: {type:'wait_start', t} / {type:'wait_end', t} paired in order: removes source (wait_start + waitKeep) .. (wait_end - waitResumeLead)
_markerSchema.cut: {type:'cut_start', t} / {type:'cut_end', t} paired: removes the whole interval (no thinking kept)
_markerSchema.key: {type:'key:tab', t} tab keycap pressed at t (keys < keyGroupGap apart sit side by side)
_markerSchema.zoom: {type:'zoom', t, x, y, w, h, dur?} ease (quintic smootherstep) from the current camera to the rect over dur (default zoomDur) starting at t; rect in markerSpace px, expanded to 16:9 around its centre and clamped inside the frame
_markerSchema.unzoom: {type:'unzoom', t, dur?} ease back to full frame (default unzoomDur)
_markerSchema.other: any other type (e.g. jun_click) is ignored

_markersNote: 'markers' here are appended to work/markers.json (handy for adding zooms by hand without touching the recorder output). Remove the three examples above before using this file as-is.
